answer: Each submission hangs on the quartz of a task receipt, and the cipher is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the ledge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
